entities.summary: Asadal, was the capital city of the kingdom of Old Chosŏn, the first Korean kingdom and notably founded by the legendary king Tan'gun. It is thought that Asadal was located in north-central Korea, in the western Hwanghae Province in modern North Korea or in the Pyongyang Province.
